pr.title: Install APK 1.0.2: native notch selection and confirmation
pr.body:
Move multi-device selection and debug/test APK confirmation into NotchAny's native notch interface. Device serials identify selections; cancellation, timeout, malformed replies, and unknown IDs cannot continue to installation. Single-device release installation keeps its direct path.

Requires NotchAny 1.0.19. The 600-second action budget covers two 120-second interactions and the existing 240-second ADB timeout. English and Chinese marketplace screenshots now show the actual native picker rendered by 1.0.19 with sample emulator entries.

Validation: six isolated Python tests cover stable IDs, cancellation/timeout without installation, exact boolean confirmation, malformed replies, and ADB target/test flags; CLI package validation passed. No APK was installed during validation. Physical Android devices, full-screen/Space transitions, and multiple monitors were not exercised.

pr.title: Support .apkm split bundles (adb install-multiple)
pr.body:
## What changed

- Accept `.apkm` (APKMIRROR split bundle) files in addition to `.apk`, both in the action's `accepts` declaration and the drop rule.
- `.apkm` files are ZIP archives: the action extracts the contained split APKs (`base.apk` first) into the per-execution temp directory and installs them with `adb install-multiple -r`. Single `.apk` files keep the original `adb install -r` path.
- Debug/test detection (`debuggable` / `testOnly`) now inspects the base APK of the bundle, and the `-t` confirmation flow applies to bundles too.
- New i18n strings (zh-Hans/en): APKM extraction failure and empty-bundle errors; generalized the file-missing wording.

Verified end-to-end on a real device: extension check, extraction, manifest parse, device selection and `install-multiple` invocation all work.

## 中文说明

- 支持拖入 `.apkm` 分包（APKMirror  bundle），自动解压后用 `adb install-multiple -r` 安装，`base.apk` 排最前。
- 调试/测试包检测作用于 bundle 的 base APK，`-t` 确认流程同样适用。
- 新增两条中英文词条，微调文件不存在文案。

pr.title: Add Install APK action
pr.body: Adds an APK installer action for Android developers. Drop one APK onto the NotchAny notch to detect connected ADB devices, choose a target when multiple devices are available, and confirm debug or test APKs before installing with `adb install -t`.
